svg.title: Sectional curvature in a complex space form

cc:Work.dc:title: Sectional curvature in a complex space form
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact Theorem D.2 curves and the projected orthonormal tangent-plane construction. The plane at pi/4 has curvature plus or minus 5/2 for c=plus or minus 4; in complex dimension one only theta=0 occurs.
